messages.subject_clean: Teaching "Introduction to data analysis with R and Bioconductor"
messages.body_plain:
Hi Saskia,

Just coming across this email again, as I was about to email this group about recent progress I've made on the "genomic ranges" episode of the Carpentries lesson:
https://carpentries-incubator.github.io/bioc-project/07-genomic-ranges/index.html

When is this Biocommons course happening? From googling around, I suspect you might be referring to this one in June 2022, is that right?
https://www.biocommons.org.au/events/fundamental-r

Anyway, I've been making slow and uneven progress on the Carpentries lesson the last few months. Happy to be peer-reviewed and get feedback on the current state of the lesson.

Best
Kevin

On Sunday, 13 February 2022 at 22:42:19 UTC sas.f...@gmail.com wrote:
> Hi everyone,
>
> I have been asked to teach the fabulous "Introduction to data analysis with R and Bioconductor" course for the Biocommons project. I will be teaching online across 4 3-hour sessions. Since it is online there is the possibility to make a recording. I am not sure whether you are interested in this (also I will probably not be the best), but I am happy to share the recording.
>
> Also if you have any other experiences/tips and tricks for teaching this course please feel free to share.
>
> Best,
>
> Saskia
